text:
maria-nguyen: Quick check-in — CloudRange + SI Integr8 joint launch is T+6 days. Need a final call on MDF split, marketplace listing timing, and the QBR scorecard updates. Who can confirm numbers by EOD? :spiral_calendar:
alex-choi: I can take the MDF numbers. Quick question — do we keep the 60/30/10 split (CloudRange / SI / MDF reserve) or shift more to SI for first 60 days?
raj-patel: My read from sales is shift to SI for the first 60 days helps adoption. Can we do 50/40/10 for the pilot and then revert?
sophie-wu: 50/40/10 might eat into our co-marketing budget for QBR metrics. If adoption drives marketplace ARR, that helps scorecard. We should model both scenarios.
jordan-lee: FYI engineering can support two listing variants (standard vs featured) but need decision on the feature flag by tomorrow. If featured, we reserve burst capacity and that affects cost projections.
maria-nguyen: Good point. Alex, can you run a quick sensitivity table? Also we need the marketplace listing copy and SI integration notes for the launch announcement doc.
alex-choi: On it. Running two scenarios now. Will post numbers in this thread.
(10 minutes later)
alex-choi: Scenario A (60/30/10): projected MDF spend = $120k, expected campaign reach = 1.2M, incremental revenue = $240k in 90d. Scenario B (50/40/10): MDF = $150k, reach = 1.6M, incremental revenue = $320k. Net unit CAC cheaper in B but our co-marketing pool drops.
sophie-wu: Can you paste the small table? easier to read.
alex-choi: ```
scenario,MDF,reach,proj_rev
A,120000,1200000,240000
B,150000,1600000,320000
```
raj-patel: Thanks. From GTM: B wins on adoption but we need a commitment from SI integr8 to run two co-hosted webinars. Are they signed up for that?
maria-nguyen: I pinged their partner lead. Waiting on confirmation. If they commit, we prefer B. If not, A.
jordan-lee: Also to be explicit: featured listing (adds 15% latency buffer cost). If we go featured + B, ops cost bump ~ $8k/mo. Approve?
sophie-wu: Put that in the budget ask as an ops line item. We shouldn't hide infra costs in MDF.
maria-nguyen: Agreed. Action items: 1) Alex finalize table + updated MDF ask (due EOD) 2) Raj confirm SI webinar commit (due tomorrow) 3) Jordan confirm capacity delta and flag in launch doc (due EOD) 4) Sophie update QBR scorecard draft to reflect the split scenarios (due tomorrow).
raj-patel: I'll chase SI tonight. If they sign, I'll post a short confirmation here.
deploy-bot: Reminder: launch-playbook PR opened by @maria-nguyen — review requested. https://git.company/repo/launch-playbook/pull/42
maria-nguyen: thanks bot :raised_hands: — everyone, if you can react to the PR and drop the numbers into the 'budget' section, I'll consolidate and send a final to legal/comms by tomorrow AM.
alex-choi: Posted final numbers and noted ops delta in the PR.
sophie-wu: Scorecard updated with both scenarios — added a 'switch-to-B-if-SI-commits' flag.
raj-patel: SI confirmed webinar pair and two joint case-study commitments :party_parrot:. They ask for a 6-week co-marketing runway.
maria-nguyen: Excellent — with that, leaning to Scenario B. Anyone object?
jordan-lee: No objections from eng. We can enable featured listing for launch window.
sophie-wu: No objection. I'll mark Scenario B as default in the QBR materials and note the conditionality.
maria-nguyen: Great — final decision: Scenario B (50/40/10) with featured listing enabled for launch week. Alex, update MDF ask to $150k and include $8k/mo ops delta. I'll file the launch announcement draft and tag legal/comms. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
